.²1 the forming o construction of a bridge, cause-way <ab>&c.</ab>; <ls>Kau. A. 2. 1</ls>;
 {#vayogate kiM vanitAvilAso jale gate kiM Kalu setubanDaH#} <ls>Subhāṣ.</ls>; <ls>Ku. 4. 6</ls>.

 passage to Laṅkā by Nala and the other monkeys); <ls>Bhāg. 7. 14. 31</ls>.
